## Chapter Summary

Data integration is a critical aspect of modern data management, involving combining data from multiple sources to provide a unified view. This chapter covers collections, storage systems, Big Data, and how to ensure ethical data handling.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Skills you will acquire in this chapter
- Identify data types: numerical, categorical, ordinal, nominal
- Apply data collection methods and storage systems
- Understand Big Data challenges and infrastructure
- Perform data integration using ETL and schema matching
- Apply ethical frameworks: GDPR, HIPAA, anonymization
:::
